Hwy 55 Menu: A Complete Guide to Burgers, Shakes, Meals, and More

Welcome to your ultimate guide to the Hwy 55 Burgers menu, a resource for those who want to browse, order online, or simply explore the wide array of offerings available at this 1950’s-themed restaurant. Whether you’re craving a shake, crispy fry, cheesesteaks, or a full meal served with fries or tots, Hwy 55 delivers quality and flavor in every bite.

From their hand-pattied beef burgers made with fresh never frozen meat, to rich frozen custard desserts and premium sliced cheesesteaks, the Hwy 55 menu offers something for everyone. This article provides a comprehensive, 4000+ word breakdown of the menu, prices, options, and how to order online at Hwy 55 for delivery or takeout.

Hwy 55 Burgers – Fresh Never Frozen

At the heart of Hwy 55’s reputation is its signature burgers, made from fresh never frozen beef. Their commitment to quality starts with hand-pattied meat, premium sliced toppings, and soft, grilled bread or buns.

Signature Burgers

Each burger at Hwy 55 is crafted with care and served with options for fries or tots and soft drink. From classic cheeseburgers to loaded specialty options, here are some highlights:

Burger Name Ingredients Price (USD)
Hwy 55 Burger Fresh beef, American cheese, lettuce, tomato, mustard, bun $6.49
Pimento Cheeseburger Beef, pimento cheese, crispy onion ring, bacon, lettuce $7.19
John Boy & Billy Burger Cheese and tangy John Boy sauce, bacon, lettuce, tomato $7.49
All-American Cheeseburger Double hand-pattied patties, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, mayo $8.59

These classic eats are known not only for their nostalgic flavors but also their generous portions and consistent quality.

Learn more about beef freshness from University of Nebraska-Lincoln’s beef quality page.

Premium Cheesesteaks – Loaded with Sauteed Onions

Hwy 55’s cheesesteaks are a nod to East Coast comfort food with premium sliced steak, melted cheese, and loaded with sauteed onions and peppers.

Hwy 55 Cheesesteaks Menu

Cheesesteak Toppings Price (USD)
Original Cheesesteak Steak, onion, provolone, green pepper $7.89
Chicken Cheesesteak Chicken tenders, grilled onions, provolone $7.59
Jalapeño Cheesesteak Sauteed onions, pepper, jalapeños, cheese $8.19

These sandwiches are chopped and loaded with sauteed ingredients, often topped with custom sauce choices and served hot.

Read about cheesesteak origins from Visit Philadelphia’s official site.

Classic Meals and Platters – Served with Fries or Tots

Looking for a complete meal? Hwy 55 offers classic platter options that come with your choice of sides.

Platter Meals

Meal Name Description Price (USD)
Shrimp Platter Spicy shrimp, fries or tots, coleslaw, soft drink or tea $9.99
Chicken Tender Platter Breaded chicken tenders, fries, toast, slaw, drink $8.49
Hamburger Steak Platter Topped with gravy, sauteed onions, mayo, fries $9.59

Each platter is seasoned to perfection, offering a comforting and filling meal option for dine-in or delivery.

More about nutrition and classic American meals can be found on ChooseMyPlate.gov.

Fresh Salads – Light Yet Satisfying

If you’re craving something lighter, Hwy 55’s salad offerings come with mixed greens, shredded carrots, red cabbage, sliced egg, and cucumber. Customize your dressing and protein choice.

Fresh Salad Menu

Salad Type Protein Option Price (USD)
Garden Salad No meat $5.29
Grilled Chicken Salad Chicken breast $7.59
Cheeseburger Salad Ground beef patty $7.99

All salads include dressing options like ranch, honey mustard, and Italian. They’re perfect for a low-carb meal or balanced lunch.

Discover more about salad nutrition on Harvard School of Public Health.

Shakes and Frozen Custard – Classic Hwy 55 Freeze

Craving a sweet treat? Hwy 55’s shake and frozen custard selection is irresistible. These desserts pair perfectly with your burgers or make a satisfying standalone indulgence.

Hwy 55 Shakes and Custard

Dessert Type Flavors Available Price (USD)
Classic Shake Vanilla, Chocolate, Strawberry $3.99
Specialty Freeze Shake Oreo, Peanut Butter, Banana $4.79
Frozen Custard Scoop Chocolate, Vanilla $2.99
Sundae Toppings include chili, bacon, nuts $4.29

All treats are crafted with high-quality ingredients and evoke a true 1950’s soda shop vibe.

Explore the science of custard at Institute of Food Technologists.

Hwy 55 Menu Prices – Browse and Compare

Here’s a quick overview table summarizing the menu items and price range for Hwy 55:

Category Price Range (USD)
Burgers $6.49 – $8.59
Cheesesteaks $7.59 – $8.19
Platters $8.49 – $9.99
Salads $5.29 – $7.99
Shakes & Custards $2.99 – $4.79

Prices may vary slightly by location, especially across NC or different states. Taxes and fee for food delivery may apply.

Ordering and Delivery – Online and App Options

Hwy 55 makes it easy to order online through their app or website. You can choose delivery or takeout, depending on your preference.

How to Order Online at Hwy 55

  1. Visit the Hwy 55 official website.

  2. Select your restaurant location.

  3. Browse the menu and customize your order.

  4. Choose takeout, deliver, or dine-in.

  5. Complete your checkout and track your delivery or pickup status.

Delivery Apps

In some locations, Hwy 55 is available on third-party platforms like:

  • DoorDash

  • Uber Eats

  • Grubhub

These apps may apply a delivery fee and offer estimated pm UTC times for drop-off.

For more about safe and efficient food ordering, visit CDC’s guidelines on food delivery.

Special Highlights – Classic Eats and More

Hwy 55’s strength lies in its dedication to nostalgic dining and customer satisfaction since 1991. With its classic eats, attention to fresh ingredients, and reliable delivery, it remains a staple for families and foodies.

What Makes Hwy 55 Unique?

  • Experience since 1991 in burger craftsmanship

  • Never-frozen beef and hand-prepared ingredients

  • A wide variety of meal options: shake, burger, cheesesteak, platter

  • Consistent quality for dine-in or order online

  • Rich frozen custard and dessert choices

Craving upscale Southern-inspired dining with clearly listed prices? Explore the full J. Alexander’s menu for a refined restaurant experience with detailed pricing and signature dishes.

Common Questions (Hwy 55 FAQ)

Is Hwy 55 Open Yet and Will Open Today?

Hours vary by location. To check if a restaurant is open, please enable JavaScript and view real-time hours on their store locator.

What Should I Know Before Ordering?

  • Some items may carry an allergy warning

  • Delivery menu may differ slightly from dine-in

  • Ask if fried onion straws or shredded cheese are available on request

Final Thoughts – Tasty, Reliable, Classic

From billy’s grillin options to modern app-based delivery, Hwy 55 offers a unique blend of tradition and innovation. Whether you crave a premium burger topped with gravy or a custard freeze, Hwy 55 is more than a meal—it’s a nostalgic experience worth repeating.
